p: fled from Naioth in Ramah: For Saul was detained, and prophesied a day and a night by God's providence, that David might have time to escape.
step between me and death: I am in great danger of death.
new moon: At what time there would be a solemn sacrifice, Nu 28:11, to which they added peace offerings and feasts.
yearly sacrifice there for all the: Read 1Sa 1:21.
determined by my father to come: That he were fully determined.
shall tell me: If your father favours me.
do so and much more to: The Lord punish me most grievously.
that I die not: I know that if you were given the kingdom now, you would not destroy me, but show yourself friendly to my posterity.
LORD hath sent thee away: The Lord is the author of your departure.
clean: Yet he might have some business to let him.
the son of Jesse to meat: Thus he speaks contemptuously of David.
son of the perverse rebellious woman: You are always contrary to me as your mother is.
slain: For it was too great tyranny to put one to death and not to give a reason why.
at the time appointed with David: For this was the third day, as it was agreed on in 1Sa 20:5.
Make speed: By these words be admonished David what he should do.
south: It seems that he shot on the north side of the stone, least the boy should have seen David.
sworn both of us in the: Which oath he calls the covenant of the Lord in 1Sa 20:8.
